g1.label: 1. thousands of people ___ have big hopes
g1.why: People as the subject of the clause take “who” (or “that”).

g2.label: 2. actors ___ want to chase their dreams

g3.label: 3. The professions ___ they choose
g3.why: A thing as the object: use “which”/“that”, or leave the pronoun out.

g4.label: 4. The age ___ they are
g4.why: A thing as the object — “which”/“that”, or omit it.

g5.label: 5. People ___ are under 30
g5.why: People as the subject — “who”/“that”; it cannot be dropped.

g6.label: 6. young people ___ parents are in the business

g7.label: 7. the competition ___ they face
g7.why: A thing as the object — “which”/“that”, or omit it.

g8.label: 8. people ___ main income is from acting
